title: Film and surface rule evaluator
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for evaluating declarative film and surface rule nouns, blocking forbidden made-up or non-functional stamps, scoring frosted-pill caption centering and dual-channel cognitive load, repointing dead repository links to SHA-256-pinned source mirrors and verifying llms.txt parity against MCP tools.
boundaries: Missing measurements evaluate to unknown rather than fabricated zero passes.
Simulated fallback answers, made-up disclaimers and non-functional status chips fail readiness checks.
Admitting a film cut or surface readiness receipt requires an independent distinct_reviewer.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for evaluating declarative film and surface rule nouns, blocking forbidden made-up or non-functional stamps, scoring frosted-pill caption centering and dual-channel cognitive load, repointing dead repository links to SHA-256-pinned source mirrors and verifying llms.txt parity against MCP tools

value.lets_workers: Evaluate declarative film and surface rule nouns across eight comparison operators with honest unknown propagation, detect forbidden made-up stamps at native frame resolution, check frosted-pill caption centering and competing dual-channel load, rewrite dead external repository URLs to SHA-256-pinned /source/ mirror routes and verify 1:1 llms.txt tool parity against MCP tools/list.

flow.when: Run declarative pre/post rule nouns, scan native-resolution OCR spans for forbidden stamps and verify frosted-pill centering and dual-channel reading load.
Rewrite dead external repository links to self-hosted /source/ mirror anchors/archives and verify /llms.txt tool parity against MCP tools/list.
Independently verify zero block failures, zero simulated fallbacks and complete mirror link resolution before sign-off.

value.worked_example: Made-up 9-rule film and surface bundle recomputed in test_film_surface_rules.py: passes 8 active operators plus 1 advisory note, blocks 2 forbidden stamps and 2 non-functional status chips on a dirty fixture, verifies 1.0 px frosted-pill centering, rewrites 3 dead repository URLs to /source/ mirror and intake routes, and confirms 4-tool llms.txt MCP parity.

nouns.title: Guardrail: missing measurements stay unknown and simulated fallbacks or made-up stamps fail closed
nouns.category_reason: Prevents unmeasured metrics or simulated demo fallbacks from masquerading as verified functionality.

value.rule: Absent or null measurements never coerce to 0; any forbidden non-functional stamp, building/needed chip or simulated demo fallback blocks readiness.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_declarative_rule_nouns returns unknown on missing paths, scan_forbidden_stamps_and_chips blocks forbidden text and verify_llms_txt_and_mcp_parity rejects has_simulated_fallback.

nouns.title: Guardrail: film cut and surface readiness receipts require an independent reviewer
nouns.category_reason: Preserves independent review before publishing cuts or surface mirror updates.

value.rule: The worker reviewing rule-noun, mirror-relink and MCP parity receipts cannot share worker_id or key_id with the producer.

nouns.title: Specification: eight declarative rule operators, frosted-pill geometry and dual-channel load limits
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic thresholds and operator semantics for film and surface verification.

nouns.title: Deterministic /source/ mirror URL rewrite and /llms.txt MCP parity procedure
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model procedure repointing dead external repo links and checking documented MCP tools.

route_rules: Repository tree/blob subpaths rewrite to /source/#<slug>:<subpath>@<commit12> with pinned archive SHA-256 prefix.
Repository /issues/new links rewrite to live intake doors (/nonprofits) rather than dead issue trackers.
value.mcp_parity_rule: Every stated N tools count and bulleted tool name in /llms.txt matches live MCP tools/list 1:1 with zero simulated fallback.

nouns.title: Tool card: standard-library declarative film rule evaluator, stamp scanner, mirror rewriter and MCP parity gate
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python 3.10+ standard-library package pinned by path and SHA-256.

value.name: film and surface rule evaluator

does_not: Modify video binaries in place, fabricate missing metrics or run live network calls.
